sentences.japanese: 教会が島中に建てられた。
sentences.english: Churches were erected all over the island.

sentences.japanese: 丘の中腹に建っている建物は私たちの学校です。
sentences.english: The building which stands on the hillside is our school.

sentences.japanese: 丘の上に建っているので彼の家は見晴らしがよい。
sentences.english: Situated on a hill, his house commands a fine view.

sentences.japanese: 丘の上に建っている家はとても古い。
sentences.english: The house which stands on the hill is very old.

sentences.japanese: 記念碑が公園に建てられた。
sentences.english: The monument was set up in the park.
